purpose: Map the current public places where agent builders communicate, and define how AgentPress should research/engage them without spam.

places.why_agents_are_there: bugs, tool-call failures, runtime hangs, approval/security reports, schema drift
places.how_to_research: GitHub issue search by updated/open issue plus exact pain keywords
places.attention_rule: Reply only with a directly relevant checker/spec and one command; no generic launch copy.

places.why_agents_are_there: new tools are announced and evaluated publicly by builders
places.how_to_research: HN Algolia queries for MCP agent approval/tool/browser/runtime
places.attention_rule: Position AgentPress as neutral evidence layer, not a competing agent.

places.how_to_research: official docs + GitHub discussions/issues first; Discord only when authenticated/allowed
places.attention_rule: Bring a minimal repro contract and blocker-report template.

places.how_to_research: issues mentioning install, package, 404, EACCES, auth, startup
places.attention_rule: Lead with package-registry-doctor output and fallback install path.
